title: Trainstorm Script Primitives (Generation IR) — v3
description: The SEMANTIC generation layer: an ordered array of didactic moves, each a typed knowledge structure, realized DOWNSTREAM into presentation elements. Governed, closed vocabulary — a new primitive type requires a version bump. V3 CHANGE (2026-09-25, Jake's instructional-move candidates, reconciled): adds the parked `scenario` type (PATCH-script-primitives-scenario.md, drafted against v1, never applied) with a closed `variant` list (branching / incomplete_information / proceed_clarify_escalate / competing_principles); adds seven standalone moves (mental_model, conditional_rule, misconception, failure_case, worked_example, evidence_inspection, unresolved_question); extends role_relevance (perspectives) and resource_pointer (resource_kind). v2 is unchanged and stays valid for existing scripts. Every type carries an `x-menu` annotation {label, use_when, not_for}: the design-commitment move menu (agents/_studio/03_design_commitment/move_menu.md) is PROJECTED from these annotations by tools/project_move_menu.py — never hand-edited. `x-candidate-crosswalk` records where each of the 17 candidate names landed, including the three that are not script moves.

knowledge_check.description: V2 FORM — a check for understanding in RESPONSE-FEATURE form. Describes what a correct response must contain, not lettered options. Options are a RENDER: the realizer generates them at realization time (key from expected_response_features; distractors from misconception_predictions via the Generator's divergent pass, with parity constraints — vocabulary, register, length). Render targets choose form (MC/MR/TF/matching/sequence) and capacity (Storyline supports up to 10 choices) as render parameters, not schema facts. If a client or SME mandates fixed verbatim options, that is a render-time constraint recorded against the render target — the primitive stays semantic. Migration from v1: each v1 options[correct=true] label maps into expected_response_features; each incorrect label is restated as the misconception it evidences.

prompt.description: The question or task, semantically stated. Single-concept; the realizer enforces form rules per target.

expected_response_features.description: What a correct response must contain or demonstrate — competency-aligned features, not option text. The semantic key.

misconception_predictions.description: Structured priors about learner error. Distractors are generated FROM these — never invented alongside the key.

feedback_incorrect.description: Default remediation when no specific misconception is matched. Misconception-specific feedback lives on each prediction.

source_reference.description: Citation into the source store (authoritative band) grounding this check. Provenance per check — the profiles' discipline, kept.

teaches.description: objective_ids this primitive was drafted toward. For knowledge_check especially, this is the field that should have prevented drift: the check's teaches and the realized element's intent.teaches are testing whether the same objective was meant both times.

scenario.description: A branching decision the learner works through: a real situation, one or more decision points, and choices whose consequences and feedback differ by QUALITY on a gradient — not a single right/wrong check (that is knowledge_check). Structural home for scenario_select interactions; delivery is interactive (behavior-driven / Storyline).

variant.description: V3, closed. branching = the general form (a single decision point is the 'decision point' move). incomplete_information = the learner must act, or decide what to find out, without all the facts (requires missing_information). proceed_clarify_escalate = every choice is one of the three moves (every branch requires action). competing_principles = a dilemma: two or more legitimate principles pull apart and no choice is 'optimal' (requires principles).

missing_information.description: V3. What the learner does not (and cannot yet) know in the situation. Required for incomplete_information.

principles.description: V3. The legitimate principles in tension. Required for competing_principles.
